catalog.purpose: Source-built Haskell Parsec development fixtures for operator precedence, backtracking, and exact error positions.
catalog.title: Parsec

activation: Run {prefix}/bin/cpg-parsec-fixture; the launcher resolves native libraries within the selected prefix.

locations.label: Native task fixture
locations.purpose: Run the 27 AST, backtracking and diagnostic assertions.

locations.label: Unchanged upstream source
locations.purpose: Inspect and adapt Parsec itself; original Hackage archive and BSD notice are retained beside it.

locations.label: Original fixture source
locations.purpose: Concrete AI-editable Haskell parser examples with expected results.

notes: Source installation compiles all 25 upstream modules, installs into a private GHC package-db, and links fixtures using the exact installed package-id.
The published portable prefix contains the native development fixtures, runtime libraries and original source materials; it does not claim a relocatable registered GHC library/package-db.
GHC and selected native bootstrap archives are bundled build support, not additional catalog resources.
The build requires a preprovisioned GNU C toolchain, Python and Linux libseccomp. No deployment download occurs.
Ubuntu 24.04 describes this reference build; CPG checks OS/architecture and actual runtime libraries rather than a distribution-name allowlist.
This is bounded native functional evidence, not Dataset, official Benchmark, OCI or other-architecture qualification.
usage.summary: Native Parsec development fixtures linked to the exact source-built library, with original source and licenses.
